messages:
kevin: Morning — quick pulse check. We got a couple of last-minute backports targeting v1.14.0. Should we extend the changelog cutoff by 2h? :clock1:
anna: what's the ETA on the backports landing? if <2h I'd say extend, otherwise keep cutoff.
maria: two PRs are queued, both need a small test tweak. I can shepherd one, josh can take the other. probable merge in ~90m if no surprises.
josh: confirming I can take the second. Do we want to add those as separate entries or squash under "bug fixes"?
kevin: separate one-liners please. short and template-compliant. remember to include PR# and component tag.
anna: pinging the release checklist: please use the one-liner template under docs/release/templates. Minimal shape: 
```
Component: eng-runtime
Summary: Fix OOM during long KV-cache sessions when quantized models used (PR #1429)
```
Use present tense, keep under one sentence.
maria: got it. i'll add: 
Component: serving
Summary: Fix race in batch coalescer causing dropped requests (PR #1432)
adding now.
release-bot: Reminder: changelog cutoff for v1.14.0 is scheduled for 2189991300 UTC. If you need an extension, reply here with reason.
kevin: thanks bot. given the merge ETA, let's extend to 2189992500 (2h30m) to be safe. any objections?
josh: fine by me. quick note — if anyone's entry touches perf numbers, flag it so QA can run the microbench.
anna: no perf changes in these two.
kevin: ok locking extension. action items: maria and josh to PR changelog one-liners, use component tags, include PR#s. release captain (me) will run a quick lint sweep after merges.
maria: filing PR now. cc @kevin for final check.
josh: likewise.
kevin: once merged i'll run the changelog-lint job: `scripts/release/check_changelog.py --range v1.13..HEAD` — please fix any lint errors immediately.
anna: tiny PSA: follow the pronoun "Fix" vs "Fixed" rule from templates (present tense). small but we enforce it for consistency.
release-bot: Cutoff extended to 2189992500 by kevin. Audit note recorded.
kevin: thanks all. will post final freeze and bump instructions when lint is clean. :thumbsup:
